create_llama4_processor: create a Llama4Processor instance with an image processor and tokenizer for multimodal text-image inputs
process_multimodal_input: process text with image placeholders and associated images into tokenized input_ids and pixel_values for a Llama4 model
build_image_token_sequence: build a structured image token sequence with patch, tile separator, and image boundary tokens based on aspect ratio
configure_chat_template: configure the Llama4 chat template that handles system messages, tool calls, images, and ipython roles
tokenize_multimodal_batch: tokenize a batch of multimodal prompts containing text and embedded image placeholders into model-ready inputs
